title: Apollo 11 lands people on the Moon
summary: Apollo 11’s lunar module landed on the Moon on 20 July 1969. Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin explored the surface while Michael Collins remained in lunar orbit.

claims.text: Apollo 11’s lunar module landed on the Moon on 20 July 1969. Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin explored the surface while Michael Collins remained in lunar orbit.
Landing date is 20 July in both UTC and US Eastern time.
The landing and first step have different timestamps. This record dates the landing; the first step fell on 21 July in UTC, though still 20 July in US Eastern time.
